- Removed outdated or redundant workflow documentation (WORKFLOW.md).

- Initial release of 37Soul skill.
- Enables integration of your AI agent with 37Soul virtual Host characters.
- Supports receiving messages, generating in-character responses, and automatic real-time replies.
- Allows posting tweets, replying to user messages, and viewing social stats through your agent.
- Provides clear setup steps and example usage for easy onboarding.

Initial release of the 37Soul skill, enabling AI-powered conversations for 37Soul Host characters.

- Connect your AI agent to 37Soul Hosts using an API token.
- Receive and reply to user messages, tweet as your Host, and manage conversation history.
- Engage with messages in real time, including replying to Host tweets and checking social stats.
- Includes detailed setup instructions, usage examples, and API references.
- Supports both automatic and manual interaction modes.
